blocks.text: One world, all of it connected

The pages that should have carried the rest of the record fell everywhere — so the whole world is a hunting ground. It is **one land**: walk out of Lastline and the ground simply goes on, through fields, woods and hills, with no door and no loading screen between a town and the country around it.
The world is still being written outward from Lastline. Land that is not written yet has no ground to stand on, and more of it opens as it is built.

Every stretch of land is one kind of ground — meadow, forest, high ground, riverbank, coast, desert — and the creatures living on it are ones that belong there. The farther you walk from a town, the higher their level. Close to town you meet them as they are; farther out, their **Tainted** and then **Blighted** versions take over.

Every creature comes from a **biome** — the kind of country its page fell in — and the biome decides which element **most** of its creatures carry. A majority, never a rule: a Snow creature is most often Water, but some are Earth.

items: **Corrupted** — where the blankness runs deepest; the most twisted pages gather here. Mostly Dark.

blocks.text: The **Monsters** page lists every creature with its biome and its element.

The land is not flat. It rises into hills and high ground and falls away into river valleys. Where it rises too steeply there is a **cliff**, and you cannot climb a cliff face — go round to where the ground slopes up gently, and walk onto the top from there. Roads cross the rivers on **bridges**.
Monsters walk exactly the ground you walk: any slope you can climb, they can climb after you, and a cliff that stops you stops them too.

Every journey starts in **Lastline**. It is the only town with townsfolk so far — its shop, the people with work for you, and its **Keeper**, standing in the middle of town. Other towns open as they are built. Walk up to the Keeper and press **F** to open the Keeper's window. A Keeper does three things.

items: **Save Point** — this town becomes the place you come back to, in front of its Keeper. Falling in battle and choosing *Return to last saved point* brings you there, and so does a Butterfly Wing. Until you set one, you come back in front of Lastline's Keeper too.

**Storage** — one storage for your whole **account**: every character you play opens the same one. It holds **600** different things; a stack of one item counts as one, and each piece of gear counts as one and comes back out exactly as it went in — its folds, its grade, its written stats, its cards. A few items, like the Newbie Potion, cannot be stored.
**Teleport** — to another town's Keeper, for Unsigned. Lastline's Keeper is the only one so far, so there is nowhere to send you yet.

blocks.text: Two things you can carry do a little of a Keeper's work anywhere. Both are sold by tool dealers, and each is used up when it works.

items: **Butterfly Wing** — returns you to your save point, from anywhere in the world. If the trip cannot be made, the wing comes back to your bag.
**Fly Wing** — sets you down on a random spot of the land around you, always one you can walk back from. If there is nowhere to land, it stays in your bag.

text: *Status: the world is one connected land, written outward from Lastline. Lastline is the only town with townsfolk, a shop and a Keeper so far; the other towns open as they are built.*
